shortDescription: Rajasthan SET Online Form 2026 – last date extended to 10 August 2026. Exam on 13 September 2026. Apply at uok.ac.in for Assistant Professor eligibility.
content:
The University of Kota conducts the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) 2026 for determining eligibility for Assistant Professor in Rajasthan colleges and universities.

Online applications started on 14 June 2026. The last date has been extended (latest extension up to 10 August 2026 as per date-extension notices). Exam is scheduled for 13 September 2026.

Exam pattern (overview)

  • Paper I: Teaching/research aptitude, reasoning, comprehension, general awareness
  • Paper II: Subject chosen by candidate

Fee

  • General / Other State: ₹1500
  • EWS / SBC / OBC: ₹1200
  • SC / ST / PH: ₹750

Apply and download extension notices only from uok.ac.in.
